'''Reading and the Soulbound''' is one of the magic systems of the Willverse.

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The magic system revolves around the concept of [[Soulbound]] individuals and their connection to [[Vessels]]. [[Soulbound]] are humans who borrow powers from entities known as [[Elders]] or [[Kameira]], and they are characterized by their bond to a [[Vessel]]. A [[Vessel]] serves as a source of power that can be sealed, and it acts as an entity or internal power that reacts to the user's emotions. During a process called [[Awakening]], a [[Soulbound]] person becomes bound to these powerful objects or entities. Because [[Vessels]] are so central to these individuals, identifying them quickly is considered critical. While most [[Soulbound]] possess useful powers, they are rare on the continent, and it is believed that all [[Greenwardens]] belong to this group.

A core component of interacting with the world is [[Intent]]. This concept involves lending a property to an object, such as wood, copper poles, or doors, over time to help that item perform its function more effectively. Practitioners can focus their [[Intent]] with extreme precision, much like a scalpel.

The [[technique]] of [[Reading]] allows a practitioner to focus their mind on an object or sense a ship. This method is used to ensure a ship accepts new additions and can even be used to perceive the awareness of an entity like an [[Elderspawn]]. However, pushing oneself too far can result in a condition known as [[Reader’s burn]], which can persist for months and must be avoided.

[[Great Elders]] represent a significant tier of power within this system. These entities are so powerful that they can blight the weather, and some islands are even haunted by them. While a mortal man can be bound to the heart of a [[Great Elder]], reading the body of such an entity is a dangerous task that practitioners avoid. Certain groups, like the [[Sleepless]], seek to communicate with these [[Great Elders]] to gain their wisdom, as many of these entities view themselves as benefactors.}}

<tr class="spoiler-fact" data-book="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow"><td>[[Kelarac]]</td><td>A [[Great Elder]] residing beneath the sea who gathers power by granting wishes in exchange for valuable items.</td></tr>
<tr class="spoiler-fact" data-book="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow"><td>[[Ach'magut]]</td><td>A dead [[Great Elder]] and mass of appendages sealed beneath [[Silverreach]] that feasts on the collected knowledge of humanity.</td></tr>
<tr class="spoiler-fact" data-book="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow"><td>[[Urg’naut]]</td><td>The [[Creeping Shadow]] is a [[Great Elder]] silhouette of solid [[Shadow{{!}}shadow]] that seeks to destroy the world to achieve absolute nothingness.</td></tr>
